items.title: MECH-266 competing-goals / switch-cost asymmetry on mode-governance-engagement substrate: goal_state clone fix + salience_affinity_input_cap; successor to 464d which still self-routed non_contributory (occupancy gate)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-464d (NOT a supersede). 464d re-enabled use_external_task_drive but still FAILed non_contributory (fraction_in_external_task=0.0 on every seed/arm), diagnosed 2026-08-12 (chip-20260812-mech266-external-task-occupancy; substrate_queue.json mode-governance-engagement entry) to TWO compounding bugs: (1) _clone_for_arm() dropped GoalState's z_goal attractor on clone (GoalState is a plain object, not an nn.Module, so trained_agent.state_dict() silently omits it, hard-gating external_task_drive's engagement to 0 via external_task_drive_require_goal_active); fixed with an explicit goal_state.state_dict()/load_state_dict() clone (both pre-existing on GoalState, previously unused by any driver). (2) dacc_pe uncapped (~15-17 throughout eval) dominated external_task_drive's [0,1]-bounded contribution by two orders of magnitude; fixed substrate-side via the new no-op-default salience_affinity_input_cap knob (ree-v3 9bcde4cb63, landed 2026-08-12), opted in here at AFFINITY_INPUT_CAP=2.0 (a scratch-diagnostic calibration starting point, NOT yet re-derived against the full 3-seed curriculum -- this run IS that calibration check). RE-DERIVE BRAKE (MECH-266, count=4: failure_autopsy_SD-034-closure-cluster-ext_2026-06-12, failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-460b-461b-464b-466b_2026-06-04, failure_autopsy_backlog_2026-07-24, failure_autopsy_grandfathered-r5-batch23-mixed-findings_2026-08-08) -- RELEASED: the substrate_queue.json mode-governance-engagement entry names exactly this corrected_validation_run as its own unblocking condition, and the required substrate (salience_affinity_input_cap) is now landed on ree-v3 main. GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout fraction_in_external_task is not recoverable from existing manifests -- every prior 464b/c/d manifest recorded it as a hard 0.0 under the unfixed substrate (a different, broken substrate state), so a fresh run is required. Gate structure (contact guard + occupancy non-vacuity gate) UNCHANGED from 464d -- only the substrate underneath it is fixed. Dry-run: end-to-end, self-routes substrate_not_ready at dry (toy-budget) scale exactly as designed (ARM_ASYM_STICKY_TASK occupancy jumped 0.0->1.0 vs predecessor at toy scale, confirming the fix engages; ARM_SYMMETRIC occupancy still below floor at toy episode-length, expected and not evidence against the fix). validate_experiments --strict clean, 0 warnings. z_goal_stream sanity check confirms goal_state writer active (active_frac~0.999, writer_defect=False, n_agents=3).

items.title: SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 slot-differentiation retest on occupied-slots-only slot_cosine_sim DV (repairs 436d methodology-check confound); supersedes V3-EXQ-436d
items.note: V3-EXQ-436e: SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166 slot-differentiation retest on an OCCUPIED-SLOTS-ONLY slot_cosine_sim DV. Discharges the DV-repair obligation recorded by failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-436d-methodology-check_2026-08-07 (confirmed, user-confirmed): 436d (the first lineage run with a working write path, P0 clean, no known substrate defect) had its C1 FAIL 2/5 seeds, HELD pending a methodology check, which found the whole-bank slot_cosine_sim DV itself fatally confounded on five independent grounds -- not the substrate: (F1) WAKING_ONLY performed ZERO ContextMemory writes (sd016_writepath_mode held at off for both conditions); (F2) an unwritten bank reads ~0 not ~1.0, so ARC-045s near-1.0 calibration point was an artifact of the legacy write-gate defect 436d itself repaired; (F3) the statistic is a PRODUCT of similarity x occupancy-fraction, not similarity alone; (F4) this makes it anti-correlated with the differentiation mechanism it was written to detect -- a 12-slot near-orthogonal arm scored 8x WORSE than a 1-slot arm; (F5) WAKING_ONLYs entire observed 0.0009-0.47 spread was reproduced by Adam-optimizer drift alone on context_memory.memory with ZERO writes; (F6) 2/5 seeds sat inside the untouched-bank null, making C1 unsatisfiable there by construction. Disposition applied 2026-08-07 governance: evidence_direction weakens->non_contributory, epistemic_category ->measurement_test_design_defect, on SD-017/ARC-045/MECH-166; pending_retest_after_substrate stays true, re-scoped to pending-DV-repair. This experiment implements all six items of the autopsys Recommendation #4: (1) statistic over occupied slots only, tracking ContextMemory.write() own min_idx directly via a read-only instance-level wrapper around the single shared write() method (all 3 call sites funnel through it); (2) similarity (c) and occupancy (k) reported separately, never as their product -- OLD whole-bank stat kept verbatim as slot_cosine_sim_raw_whole_bank for audit, never gating; (3) WAKING_ONLY given a real write path (sd016_writepath_mode=sense_only, held constant vs SWS_THEN_REM which shares it plus the offline consolidation writes) -- a THIRD condition, NO_WRITES, added as a calibration-only negative control, not part of the C1 comparison; (4) Adam drift neutralized (context_memory.memory.requires_grad_(False), all 3 conditions); (5) predicted baseline re-derived empirically at run time (fresh untouched-bank-null draws matching ContextMemory own init recipe) rather than reusing the stale near-1.0 figure; (6) NO_WRITES arm checked against that re-derived null as a P0 calibration gate (adam_drift_neutralized, max|z|<4sigma). Two NEW P0 gates beyond that: waking_writepath_engaged (pooled WAKING_ONLY write() calls > 0) and sufficient_occupancy_for_c1 (>=3/5 seeds with >=2 occupied slots in BOTH comparison arms -- the direct F6 fix, so an unscoreable seed self-routes the run to FAIL/non_contributory rather than silently shrinking the denominator). C1s SHAPE is unchanged from 436d: paired, directional, >=3/5 seeds, same seeds [42,7,13,100,200], same TRAINING_EPISODES/STEPS_PER_EPISODE/SLEEP_INTERVAL, same action-selection wiring. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): the decisive readout (occupied-only cosine on the repaired write path) exists in NO recorded manifest -- the autopsy itself states 436ds own occupied-only statistic is not recomputable post-hoc (no per-slot memory snapshot persisted) -> not recoverable, must run. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): all three claims epistemic_category is measurement_test_design_defect (not substrate_ceiling), and the artifact explicitly states no substrate build is owed -- brake does not apply; this is instrument repair, exactly the routing the brake exists to permit. Substrate readiness (2.5/2.5a): no new substrate required -- ContextMemory.write(), sense()s sd016_writepath_mode=sense_only hook, and run_sws_schema_pass/run_rem_attribution_pass all pre-exist and were re-verified live against ree_core source plus an empirical probe (write() min_idx computation, requires_grad_(False) interaction, occupancy growth over a real training loop). Smoke (--dry-run): all 3 conditions wire, WAKING_ONLY n_write_calls=131 (was 0 in 436d), SWS_THEN_REM sws_n_writes=8/rem_n_rollouts=6, both comparison arms clear the >=2-occupied-slot floor (4 and 5 slots), NO_WRITES stays at exactly 0 write calls. Additionally end-to-end exercised the full (non-dry-run) P0/C1/degeneracy aggregation path with a shrunk config (2 seeds, 25 episodes) -- correctly self-routed to insufficient_occupancy_for_c1 when one seed collapsed to a single dominant slot, confirming the new occupancy-floor gate works as designed rather than silently deflating the denominator; JSON-serializable end to end. validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings. validate_recording.py --strict on the smoke manifest: OK (0 always-core gaps). Ethics preflight: all-false / allow (V3 pre-ethical, unchanged from 436d).
